keys.swarm.aura_piercing_bolt_desc: A bolt charges up, then fires through a long line of monsters.
keys.swarm.aura_piercing_bolt_ten: Railshot: a beam across the whole screen.
keys.swarm.aura_falcon_companion_desc: A falcon circles above and dives on monsters, then climbs again.
keys.swarm.aura_falcon_companion_ten: The Stormhawk: each dive throws lightning to up to 3 additional monsters.
